title: Eight Hand Paths
lede: 72 CAPs by {0}, all built on eight hand paths.
hands-title: One hand caps, the other circles
hand-left: Left hand: two on, one back
credit: CAPs by Gage DeMello, transcribed from Mentive's SpiroAnim.
path-1: Path 1: the hands start split and set off opposite ways.
path-2: Path 2: the hands start together and set off opposite ways.
path-3: Path 3: the hands start together and set off the same way.
path-4: Path 4: the hands start split and set off the same way.
path-5: Path 5: the hands start a quarter apart, left hand ahead, and set off the same way.
path-6: Path 6: the hands start a quarter apart, left hand behind, and set off the same way.
path-7: Path 7: the hands start a quarter apart, swapping first, and set off opposite ways.
path-8: Path 8: the hands start a quarter apart, turning apart first, and set off opposite ways.
corner-hands: The bottom right corner shows the hands' element on each beat.
props-split-same: The props are water: they open split, turning the same way.
props-split-opposite: The props are fire: they open split, turning opposite ways.
props-together-same: The props are earth: they open together, turning the same way.
props-together-opposite: The props are air: they open together, turning opposite ways.
props-quarter-same: The props are sun: they open a quarter apart, turning the same way.
props-quarter-opposite: The props are moon: they open a quarter apart, turning opposite ways.
corner-props: The top right corner shows the props' element. It changes when the beat back changes their timing.
props-drift-same: The props turn the same way on every beat. Their turns differ, so their timing drifts and they have no element. Give both hands the same turns to name one.
props-drift-opposite: The props turn opposite ways on every beat. Their turns differ, so their timing drifts and they have no element. Give both hands the same turns to name one.
back-note: On its beat back the left hand switches between pro and anti. The chart gives that beat no turns after anti and one after pro. Left, back lets you pick another.
paths-body: Each path starts with a timing and a direction. The direction flips every time the left hand turns back.
timing-split-body: The hands start on opposite sides.
timing-together-body: The hands start at the same point.
timing-quarter-body: The hands start a quarter apart.
poi-anti-zero: Poi can't do this one. At 0 turns at least one beat spins anti, and a poi can't antispin with 0 turns. Every other prop can.
poi-note: Poi can't do this one. A poi can point another way partway through, but the hand can only turn round while the poi points out, and here it turns round while the poi points another way. A staff can turn round pointing any way.
